completion_policy: A passing check remains Completed across builds unless a relevant character change or regression affects that result. A new ROM hash alone is not a reason to reset or repeat it.

display_statuses.Completed: A recorded passing check, regardless of unrelated ROM changes.
display_statuses.Not recorded: A qualifying result was not found in the reviewed records. Search past records before retesting.
display_statuses.Needs playtest: The available result is limited to a fixture or private test.
display_statuses.Code checks only: Code checks exist, but the gameplay check remains open.
display_statuses.Needs review: The remaining review is open; this does not mean the feature is unimplemented.
display_statuses.Partly checked: Some checks passed; the full review is still open.
display_statuses.Severe lag: Heavy lag while standing or walking remains a known issue.
display_statuses.Retest needed: Use only after a relevant change or regression affects a prior result.
